description: Farming (packages/core/docs/native-production.md §3.2): what is in this field, how long it still needs, and what comes off it. Each kb mirrors FARMING_PREDICATES_PROLOG verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run production-corpus`. The finding this file pins is an ABSENCE: v1’s FarmingSystem.rollCropType() chose the crop AT HARVEST out of a hardcoded table weighted by rarity, so a plot sown with wheat came up tomatoes — here a field yields what was sown in it, and plot_yields/3 is the case that says so. The wait is the crop’s growth less one crop_water_bonus/2 per watering, FLOORED AT ONE DAY, and the floor is the mechanic rather than a guard: a crop ready the instant it is sown is not a crop. With no crop stated, plant_choice/3 is the one a planting sows in the plot named (PL.core-craft-chooser, U110(4) Q2): the first crop, in the standard order of atoms, that can_plant/3 allows there, and no solution when none does. Every number is whole and there is no percentage anywhere in the pack — a weight is a relative integer, never a probability — and, unlike the v1 mechanic this replaces, there is NO ROLL IN THE PACK AT ALL: v1 drew Math.random() against a hardcoded content table in four separate engine classes, which no native engine can reproduce. What a seeded draw turns up is core’s and is pinned by conformance/production/draws.json instead, because a hash is not expressible as a rule (packages/core/docs/native-production.md §6, divergence P-1). What is NOT here is an item: every output atom is one conformance/prolog/mechanic-equipment.json already owns, and a second item taxonomy here would be the parallel one these four modules exist not to be. Neither is the gate on the work itself — whether a person MAY dig this seam is one more clause of forbids/4, permissible/3 belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json, and that a refused job writes nothing at all is proved end to end in packages/core/src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/ProductionDirector.test.ts.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-field-and-does-not-raise
kb: plot_wait(P, Days) :- nonvar(P), plot_crop(P, C), crop_growth(C, Growth), plot_tended(P, N), crop_water_bonus(C, Bonus), Raw is Growth - N * Bonus, Raw >= 1, !, Days = Raw.
plot_age(P, Age) :- plot_planted(P, Sown), day_number(Today), Age is Today - Sown.
plot_ready(P) :- plot_crop(P, _), plot_wait(P, Days), plot_age(P, Age), Age >= Days.
plot_yields(P, ItemId, Qty) :- plot_crop(P, C), crop_yield(C, ItemId, Qty).

can_plant(A, P, C) :- nonvar(A), plot(P), crop(C), \+ plot_crop(P, _), at_location(A, P), crop_seed(C, Seed), has_item(A, Seed, Held), Held >= 1, \+ (crop_tool(C, Tool), \+ (has_item(A, I, Q), Q > 0, item_type(I, Tool))), \+ (crop_skill(C, S, Min), \+ (has_skill(A, S, L), L >= Min)).

can_harvest(A, P) :- nonvar(A), plot_crop(P, C), at_location(A, P), plot_ready(P), \+ (crop_tool(C, Tool), \+ (has_item(A, I, Q), Q > 0, item_type(I, Tool))), \+ (crop_skill(C, S, Min), \+ (has_skill(A, S, L), L >= Min)).
plant_choice(A, P, C) :- nonvar(A), nonvar(P), can_plant(A, P, C), \+ (can_plant(A, P, Other), Other @< C).
